steps.what: Show the current fuel cell system design record.
Recommend or implement changes to these system designs.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the current fuel cell system design. The fuel cell engineer recommends the change or implements it. The record does not choose the change. Only the change note the engineer accepts is filed, and a design with no id is left with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A change was filed against a design id that the note never named.
tasks.enabler_now: The current design can be opened. The recommendation and the implementation still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a change will hold in production still has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recommends or implements the change. The design record is what is already stored.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation and the implementation stay with the engineer. Filing happens only after that change is accepted.

reach.task: Build from a design change the fuel cell engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A stored design is not the change.

evidence.claim: Opening the current design is a lookup. It does not recommend or implement a change.
Filing a change before the engineer accepts that version would store a recommendation nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The design id already stored. The change text is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the design in the document store before writing the change note.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether implementation notes and recommendation notes share one change record.
research_questions: Who confirms the design id is the design now in use?

already_counted.description: Recommending or implementing the change stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop change notes whose design record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: design id and the change sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still recommends the change or implements it. Only opening the current design, and filing the change already accepted, is removed. A design with no id saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the design record and the tests stored for it.
Validate design of these fuel cells and components.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the design and the test records stored for that same design. The fuel cell engineer validates the cells, components, or systems. A test stored for another design is not this validation. Only the validation the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A design was called validated from a test that belonged to a different stack.
tasks.enabler_now: Tests stored for this design can be opened. The validation still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A weakness the stored tests do not cover still has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer validates the design. The test list is the records already stored for that design.
tasks.altitude: Validation stays with the engineer. The note is filed only after that validation is accepted.

reach.task: Use a validation the fuel cell engineer has accepted for this design.
reach.learn: A test from another design is not this validation.

evidence.claim: Opening tests stored for this design is a lookup. It does not validate the cells, the components, or the system.
Filing a validation before the engineer accepts that version would store a pass nobody gave.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The design id and test ids already linked to that same design. A test linked to another design is not shown as this validation. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the design and its own tests in the document store before writing the validation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether component tests and system tests share one link to the design.
research_questions: Who links a test record to a design id?

already_counted.description: Validating the design stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop test links whose design record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: design id, test ids, and the validation sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still validates the cells, components, or systems. Only opening the design and the tests already stored for that same design, and filing the validation already accepted, is removed. A test from another design saves none of the validation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show saved papers and the meeting already on the calendar.
Read current literature and attend meetings with colleagues.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows papers already saved, and the {CALENDAR} shows the meeting already scheduled. The fuel cell engineer still reads the literature and still attends the meeting or talks with colleagues. A saved title is not the reading. Nothing is summarized in place of that work.
tasks.previous_blocker: A title list was treated as the reading, and the meeting still had to be attended.
tasks.enabler_now: A saved paper and a scheduled meeting can be opened. The reading and the conversation still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A competitive product the papers do not mention still has to be heard from a colleague.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer reads and attends. The title and the meeting slot are already stored.
tasks.altitude: Reading and the meeting stay with the engineer. A saved title is not treated as the reading.

reach.task: Pass on a paper worth reading, not a summary in its place.
reach.learn: A title is not the paper.

evidence.claim: Opening a saved paper or a scheduled meeting is a lookup. It does not read the literature or hold the conversation.
A summary is not a substitute for the reading or for the meeting with colleagues.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The paper id already saved, and the meeting id already on the calendar. No summary is written by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the saved paper and the calendar meeting before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether conference notes and colleague conversations are stored as meetings.
research_questions: Who saves a paper onto the engineer's reading list?

already_counted.description: Reading the literature and attending the meeting stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop papers that have been removed from the reading list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still reads the current literature and still attends the meeting or talks with colleagues. Only opening a paper already saved, and a meeting already scheduled, is removed. A title saves none of the reading.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored setup sheet for this specific test.
Prepare test stations and instrumentation for specific tests.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the setup sheet already written for this specific test. The fuel cell engineer prepares the station, the instrumentation, or the data acquisition system. Instrument runtime is not counted. A sheet with no test id leaves the preparation with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A station was prepared from a sheet that named a different test.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored setup sheet can be opened. The station still has to be prepared by hand.
tasks.still_hard: An instrument the sheet does not name still has to be set by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer prepares the station. The sheet is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Preparation stays on the bench. The setup sheet is visible, and instrument runtime is not treated as saved labour.

reach.task: Confirm the instrument on the sheet is the one at the station.
reach.learn: A setup sheet is not the preparation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored setup sheet is a lookup. It does not prepare a station, an instrument, or a data acquisition system.
Time an instrument already spends running is not the engineer's labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The test id and the station id, both already on the setup sheet. Instrument names are not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the setup sheet on the operations record before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether data acquisition settings live on the same sheet as the instrument list.
research_questions: Who marks a setup sheet as the one for this test?

already_counted.description: Preparing the station stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop setup sheets whose test record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still prepares the station, the instrumentation, or the data acquisition system. Only opening a setup sheet that was already written is removed. Instrument runtime is not counted, and a sheet with no test id saves none of the preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fuel cell engineer still recommends the change, still validates the design, still reads the literature, and still prepares the station. A stored record can be opened. It does not do that work.
reach: Design reviewers read an accepted change, and this job learns the design record is not the recommendation.
Test technicians use a station the engineer has prepared, and this job learns a setup sheet is not the preparation.
skills_to_grow: Recommend a design change only after looking at the current design.
Validate a design against tests stored for that same design.
Read the paper and attend the meeting, rather than treating a title as the reading.
role.ambitious_version: Design changes, validation, reading, and station preparation stay with the engineer. Stored records only show what was already written.
